title: Email and Calendar Metadata: Port Wentworth Police Department and Flock Safety, Jan. 1, 2024 to Nov. 25, 2026

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. Email metadata only (sender, all recipients including cc and bcc, subject line, and date and time) for all emails between any City of Port Wentworth or Port Wentworth Police Department email account and any Flock Safety email account (any address ending in @flocksafety.com), from January 1, 2024 through the date of this request, November 25, 2026. This is metadata only, with no message body or attachments.

2. Calendar metadata (event title, date and time, location or room field, and attendee list) for any calendar entry, meeting invite, or scheduled event that involves a Flock Safety employee or representative, or names Flock Safety, over the same dates.

If the City's email is run by an outside IT provider, please ask that provider to run the search. If no emails or calendar entries match, please tell me in writing.

Please send the results as a CSV or Excel file if the system can export one. If it cannot, a PDF is fine. Because this is metadata only, I do not expect it to need review before release. If any part is withheld, please tell me which part and the specific legal authority by Code section, subsection, and paragraph, as O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(d) provides, and release the rest. Under § 50-18-71(c)(1), any charge is limited to the lowest hourly rate of a full-time employee with the skill needed, with the first quarter hour free. If the cost will be more than $25, please send an estimate that shows the hours, the hourly rate, and the employee classification. I am glad to narrow the dates if that lowers the cost. I do not authorize any work above $25 until I have approved the estimate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ethan Watters
